Unmodified upstream files retained in upstream/. FloatIsland adapts the pixel-grid overlay locally in src/main/system/pixelPickerOverlay.ts. Changes: isolated sandbox preload; trusted owner checks; all-display capture through existing capture service; main-process validated pixel sampling; no shared temporary scripts; cancellation, display changes and owner cleanup; clamped magnifier; local CSP.
